subject: microbiology
title: String Test, Vibrio parahaemolyticus, Kanagawa Phenomenon and Campylobacter jejuni

steps.tx: The **string test** emulsifies a colony in 0.5 percent sodium deoxycholate: vibrios lyse and DNA strings mucoid thread when the loop lifts (Aeromonas usually negative separating cousins), a ten second vibrio confirmation beside oxidase. Bile solubility in pneumococcus is deoxycholate's other bench career, context deciding meaning. A mucoid thread several centimetres long is easier to interpret than a barely visible wisp from an old colony.
steps.say: Deoxycholate strings vibrio DNA; the same reagent dissolves pneumococcus by autolysin.

left.title: String technique
points: Young colony on non selective agar
Loop lifted slowly for mucoid thread
Vibrio cholerae and most vibrios positive

steps.tx: **Vibrio parahaemolyticus** lives in warm coastal seawater and shellfish, thermostable direct haemolysin (TDH) strains causing seafood gastroenteritis (raw oysters, cross contaminated cooked seafood) 8 to 24 hours watery diarrhoea, self limited usually, wound infections separately, growth favoured by summer temperatures and refrigeration failures. Food histories should ask about buffets and wedding seafood as carefully as about restaurant oysters.
steps.say: Warm seas and raw oysters purge by tomorrow; cook shellfish and separate raw juices.

steps.tx: The **Kanagawa phenomenon** is parahaemolyticus beta haemolysis on Wagatsuma high salt human blood agar by TDH, marking diarrhoea associated strains (most environmental isolates negative), thermostable direct haemolysin genes (tdh, trh variants) now PCR read instead. Pathogenicity on a plate was its era's elegance.
steps.say: Human blood lysed on salty Wagatsuma agar flagged the diarrhoea strains.

right.title: Gene era
points: Type III secretion systems additional virulence

steps.tx: **Vibrio vulnificus** is the halophilic killer: oyster associated sepsis in liver disease and iron overload (primary septicaemia, bullous cellulitis, shock, half fatal untreated) and wound infections after seawater exposure, capsulated, iron hungry, doxycycline plus ceftazidime urgent, raw oyster warnings for cirrhosis its prevention.
steps.say: Cirrhosis plus raw oysters plus bullae equals vulnificus until excluded, treat in hours.

left.title: Vulnificus portrait
points: Lactose fermenting vibrio (green and yellow variants)
Iron overload and liver disease terrain

steps.tx: **Campylobacter jejuni** is a microaerophilic curved S shaped rod (seagull wings), darting, oxidase positive, growing 42 degrees on Skirrow and charcoal selective media, poultry reservoir, bloody inflammatory diarrhoea after 2 to 5 days, bacteraemia in immunocompromise, and Guillain Barre after (next lesson). It outnumbers Salmonella in many foodborne tables.
steps.say: Seagull curves at 42 degrees from chicken: Campylobacter until the panel returns.

left.title: Jejuni identity
points: Curved and spiral rods, darting motility

right.title: Jejuni disease
points: Self limited usually, antibiotics severe and early

steps.tx: **Campylobacter culture and diagnosis** (filtration through 0.45 micron onto blood agar for antibiotic free isolation, stool antigen and PCR panels common now, blood agar microaerobic jars) balances sensitivity with panel speed; fetus subspecies causes abortion bacteraemia in immunocompromised separately.
steps.say: Filter stool through pores Campylobacter threads and rivals cannot: clever old trick.

right.title: Non culture
points: Species by MALDI and hippurate heritage

steps.tx: **Campylobacter therapy** is supportive usually; azithromycin (fluoroquinolone resistance high from poultry use) for severe, early, immunocompromised and dysenteric course, erythromycin heritage, prevention by poultry kitchen hygiene (separate boards, cook through, no washing raw chicken aerosolising).
steps.say: Do not wash the chicken; cook it, board it separately, azithromycin if severe.

right.title: Drug logic
points: Bacteraemia: carbapenem or gentamicin by susceptibility

steps.tx: **Other vibrio bench habits** (salt tolerance series 0 6 10 percent, polymyxin B and O129 vibriostatic disc susceptibilities separating Vibrio from Aeromonas) complete identification heritage: cholerae grows without salt, halophiles demand it, O129 sensitivity is a classic vibrio vote.
steps.say: No salt, some salt, much salt: vibrio species by brine arithmetic.
